abstract: Previous studies have indicated that hCG has a weak intrinsic thyroid-stimulating activity. Differences in the molecular composition and biological activity of hCG in patients with trophoblastic diseases and pregnant women occur, but are not well defined. Therefore, we have studied the effect of serum samples and purified hCG preparations from patients with trophoblastic diseases on T3 release from human and porcine thyroid slices in vitro. We examined 30 serum samples from 13 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, 3 from women with choriocarcinoma, and 5 from patients with hydatidiform moles. In all but 1 serum sample from the tumor patients, but in none of 11 serum samples of pregnant women, T3-releasing activity was found. Two patients with testicular cancer and 1 patient with molar pregnancy experienced episodes of frank hyperthyroidism. Isoelectric focusing on polyacrylamide gels of tumor sera (n = 15) revealed substantial amounts of acidic isoelectric variants, pI 3.3-3.9, which were only barely detectable in pregnancy sera. The percentage of acidic hCG variants with pI 3.3-4.0 to total hCG with pI 3.3-5.2, as determined by hCG (+hCG beta) RIA of the eluted fractions of polyacrylamide gel isoelectric focussing, varied from 12-45% in sera of tumor patients and from 0-4% in pregnant sera. We purified the acidic variants of hCG with pI 3.6-3.8 (hCGav) from the urine of our patients. The beta-subunit of purified hCGav had a slightly higher mol wt (35,750) than that of hCG CR 119 (34,190) on polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis. The hCGav showed a dose-dependant stimulation of T3 release and cAMP generation from human thyroid slices, whereas the other hCG fractions on isoelectric focussing had no thyrotropic effect in similar dose levels. The TSH-like activity of hCGav could be roughly estimated as 10 mIU TSH/IU hCGav. Anti-hCG (+hCG beta) antiserum, but not anti-hTSH antiserum, neutralized the biological activity of hCGav. These findings strongly suggest that acidic hCG variants act as functional stimulators of the human thyroid in vitro. Since these molecular variants of hCG can exist in patients with trophoblastic diseases in significant amounts, they could be responsible for some cases of hyperthyroidism in trophoblastic diseases.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は弱い甲状腺刺激作用を内因的に持つことが先行研究で示されている。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者と妊婦では、hCGの分子組成と生物活性に差があるが、その詳細は明らかでない。そこで本研究では、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者の血清試料と精製hCG製剤が、ヒトおよびブタの甲状腺スライスからのT3放出に及ぼす影響をin vitroで検討した。非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者13例由来の血清30検体、絨毛癌の女性3例、胞状奇胎の患者5例の血清を検討した。腫瘍患者の血清試料では1検体を除きT3放出活性が認められたが、妊婦の血清11検体では認められなかった。精巣がんの患者2例と胞状奇胎の患者1例では甲状腺機能亢進症の発作が生じた。腫瘍患者の血清15検体の等電点電気泳動では、pI 3.3〜3.9の酸性変異体が多量に検出され、妊娠血清ではほとんど検出されなかった。等電点電気泳動で分画した溶出画分のhCG(+hCGβ)RIAで求めた、pI 3.3〜5.2の総hCGに対するpI 3.3〜4.0の酸性hCG変異体の割合は、腫瘍患者の血清では12〜45%、妊婦では0〜4%であった。患者の尿から、pI 3.6〜3.8の酸性hCG変異体(hCGav)を精製した。精製hCGavのβサブユニットは、ポリアクリルアミドゲル電気泳動でhCG CR 119(34,190)より高い分子量(35,750)を示した。hCGavは、ヒト甲状腺スライスからのT3放出とcAMP産生を用量依存的に増加させたが、等電点電気泳動で得た他のhCG分画は同用量で甲状腺刺激作用を示さなかった。hCGavのTSH様活性はIU当たり約10 mIU TSHと推定された。抗hCG(+hCGβ)抗血清は、hCGavの生物活性を中和したが、抗hTSH抗血清では中和されなかった。これらの知見は、酸性hCG変異体がin vitroでヒト甲状腺の機能的刺激因子として作用することを強く示唆する。これらの分子変異体は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者に相当量存在するため、この疾患の一部の甲状腺機能亢進症の原因となりうる。
